[2026-06-01 22:20] Review — season date-format bugfix on `fix/season-date-format`. Small, focused fix for a PO-reported live bug.

THE BUG (root-caused via live probe): Entu returns `date`-typed values as full ISO (`"2026-06-02T00:00:00.000Z"`); `listSeasons` handed that straight to `SeasonForm`'s `<input type="date">` → field renders blank, season date edits don't round-trip. Name (string) was unaffected.

CHAIN:
- RED `f07a8d3` (Tallis): `entuSeasons.spec.ts` — drives the REAL probed ISO format, asserts `listSeasons` maps `start_date[0].date = "2026-06-02T00:00:00.000Z"` → `startDate === "2026-06-02"` (full-shape toEqual); + guards for idempotent-clean and missing-date.
- GREEN `ea2cdcb` (Josquin): one change — `listSeasons` maps `?.date?.slice(0,10) ?? ''` for startDate + endDate. 1 file (+2/-2).

Gates (reported): entuSeasons 59/59, full vitest 804/804, `pnpm check` 0 (the 8 `state_referenced_locally` warnings are pre-existing from #87's RehearsalEditForm, not this change).

Josquin's consumer audit (please sanity-check): no season-date reader needs the time — validation.ts + SeriesForm date compares are string compares that are actually MORE correct with clean YYYY-MM-DD; sort uses localeCompare (fine); SeasonForm requires YYYY-MM-DD. 

Scrutinize: (a) the slice is safe for the real wire format + already-clean + missing cases (test-pinned), (b) no consumer regressed by dropping the time, (c) the RED genuinely drives the real producer (not a weakened fixture). Verify from blobs. Verdict to me — if GREEN, Josquin merges (no issue # — PO-reported bug; I'll note it) → redeploy.
